uint256 state variable storing the last generated pseudo-random result; read by getAccDetails() to decide win/lose.

uint minimumBet state variable declared but never assigned or read.
mapping(address => raceDetails) storing per-player time, luckNumber and horseType.

Caller-controlled address; used for betting, payout via transfer, member bookkeeping and manager authentication.

Constructor assigning manager = msg.sender, establishing the privileged account.

Library function multiplying two uints with an overflow assertion.
Library function performing integer division.

Raw unchecked multiplication of the caller-supplied amount by 1e15 without SafeMath: arithmetic overflow risk.
Weak randomness source built from miner-controllable block values used to determine payouts.
uint256 parameter of enter() selecting the horse/branch (1 = left, otherwise right).

uint256 local in randomtests() holding random() % 100.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written into the privileged manager state variable in the constructor.
The constructor reads msg.sender to determine the owner of the contract.
block.timestamp is fed into random() as entropy (timestamp dependency).
Miner-influenceable block.timestamp participates in the weak randomness expression.
random() builds its hash from block.difficulty, block.timestamp and now.
enter() assigns rewardnumber = randomtests().
enter() calls getMaximumBetRate() to obtain the bet cap.
The getMaximumBetRate() result is stored into maximumBalance.
maximumBalance is read in enter() to bound the accepted msg.value.
enter() calls randomtests() to obtain the outcome number.
randomtests() calls random() for entropy.
The value returned by randomtests() flows into rewardnumber.
enter() is invoked by and pays out to the caller-controlled msg.sender.
enter() writes now (block.timestamp) into members[msg.sender].time.
enter() performs the external ETH transfer to msg.sender on a winning branch.
Funds are pushed to msg.sender while the caller still has control (fallback can re-enter).
members[msg.sender] is written only after the external transfer returns.
listofUsers is pushed to only after the external transfer returns.
enter() writes time, luckNumber and horseType into the members mapping.
enter() appends msg.sender to listofUsers.
The leftorright parameter selects the betting branch inside enter().
leftorright is stored as members[msg.sender].horseType.
depositEther() authenticates the caller with require(msg.sender == manager).
withDrawalether() authenticates the caller with require(msg.sender == manager).
The amount parameter drives the payout amount in withDrawalether().
withDrawalether() multiplies amount by 1e15 without SafeMath.
The caller-supplied amount is a direct operand of the unchecked multiplication.
The unchecked product is used directly as the value of the manager transfer.
withDrawalether() executes the manager.transfer external call.
The privileged manager address is the recipient of the withdrawal transfer.
getAccDetails() indexes members with the _address parameter.
getAccDetails() reads stored race details from the members mapping.
getAccDetails() uses rewardnumber to decide the win/lose message.
getAccDetails() calls uint2str() to format the returned values.
The local index holds random() % 100 inside randomtests().
Local j is the digit-counting loop variable in uint2str().
Local length determines the size of the bstr buffer in uint2str().
Local bstr is the bytes buffer filled by uint2str().
Local k is the reverse write index into bstr in uint2str().
getAccounts() returns the listofUsers array.
numberofGamePlay() reads listofUsers.length.

normalization_plan.reason: leftorright is a parameter only of enter(); it should be normalized into the enter() function node.
_address is a parameter only of getAccDetails(); it should be normalized into the getAccDetails() function node.
amount is a parameter of withDrawalether() and feeds its unchecked multiplication; normalize into withDrawalether().
index is a local of randomtests(); normalize into the randomtests() function node.
j is a local of uint2str(); normalize into the uint2str() function node.
length is a local of uint2str(); normalize into the uint2str() function node.
bstr is a local of uint2str(); normalize into the uint2str() function node.
k is a local of uint2str(); normalize into the uint2str() function node.
